core.headline: Brook Hall, Wadhurst Road, near Frant, East Sussex TN3
core.listing:
Brook Hall is a detached Edwardian country house standing in approx. 4.5 acres near Frant, East Sussex. The property occupies a position within the High Weald National Landscape and is approached via a gated drive. The grounds include gardens, a heated outdoor pool and a 3-acre paddock.

Built in 1908, the house has brick construction with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. The ground floor provides a drawing room measuring 7.10m x 5.20m (23'4" x 17'1"), a dining room measuring 5.40m x 4.60m (17'9" x 15'1"), and two further reception rooms.

The kitchen/breakfast room measures 8.20m x 4.90m (26'11" x 16'1").

The principal bedroom measures 5.60m x 4.80m (18'4" x 15'9"). There are four further bedrooms and four bathrooms.

The gardens include a terrace and a heated outdoor pool served by an air source heat pump. An oak-framed triple cart lodge was built in 2025 with planning permission granted the same year; a one-bedroom annexe sits above. The 3-acre paddock completes the land.

Frant station is approx. 2 miles (London Bridge approx. 1 hour by rail). Royal Tunbridge Wells is approx. 4 miles.

Guide Price £2,100,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band H (Wealden District Council). EPC rating E. Construction: Standard – Brick with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (not metered). Sewerage: Treatment plant. Heating: Oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: Limited indoors; good outdoor coverage. Parking: Gated drive with parking for several cars; triple cart lodge. The property is within the High Weald National Landscape. A public footpath crosses the southern edge of the paddock. Planning permission was granted in 2025 for the cart lodge with annexe above (built). Council tax banding of the annexe has not been confirmed.
core.summary: Detached Edwardian country house in approx. 4.5 acres within the High Weald National Landscape, with heated outdoor pool, oak-framed triple cart lodge with one-bedroom annexe, and 3-acre paddock. Guide Price £2,100,000.
